title: 10 Hovve man broughte himſelfe vvith all hys poſteritie culpable of the firſt and ſecond death.

segments.text: MAn being ſuche did willingly and withoute any• compulſion Ioigne and knite hym ſelfe to the diuel, and therefore became culpable of the firſt and ſecond death withall his poſteritie: & conſequētly hath made himſelfe and all his culpable of all that, whiche leadethe to the one and other of theſe two deathes.
